description: This file defines data models and query parameters for currency snapshot data within a financial data provider system, utilizing Pydantic for data validation.

classes.name: CurrencySnapshotsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching currency snapshot data, including base currency, quote type, and optional counter currencies.

classes.name: CurrencySnapshotsData
classes.description: Represents the currency snapshot data including rates, open, high, low, close, volume, and previous close.

methods.name: to_upper
methods.description: Converts the base currency string to uppercase before validation.

methods.name: convert_string
methods.description: Converts the counter currencies input into an uppercase comma-separated string.
